name: How do I know whether to remove my cabinets or just reface them?

mainEntity.name: How do I know whether to remove my cabinets or just reface them?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should replace rather than paint or reface if your cabinet boxes have water damage, warped frames, broken particle board, or a functional layout that no longer suits your cooking needs. Refacing saves money and keeps existing layouts intact, but it cannot fix sagging shelves, mold inside sink bases, or poor workflow. If you want to change appliance placements, add an island, or install taller upper cabinets to increase storage, complete removal is the necessary first step.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remove them if the cabinet boxes have structural or water damage, or if you want to alter your kitchen layout; reface if the boxes are solid and the layout works.
